cases.name: setup: import config module into ctx
cases.execute: const CFG = "file:///" + $root.split("\\").join("/") + "/packages/main/dist/config.js"; const m = await import(CFG); $ctx.CFG = CFG; $ctx.f = m.isCommandAllowed; $ctx.ap = m.getAllowedPatterns; $ctx.lc = m.loadConfig; $ctx.rc = m.resetConfigCache; return typeof m.isCommandAllowed === "function"

cases.name: CHK-001 happy:0 — 各阶段命令正确分配
cases.execute: const f=$ctx.f; return f("story_review","PLAN") && !f("story_review","DEV") && f("fixture_batch_add","DEV") && !f("fixture_batch_add","PLAN") && f("bug_report","TEST") && !f("bug_report","DEV") && f("testintent_check","TEST_CASE_REVIEW") && !f("testintent_check","DEV")

cases.name: CHK-001 happy:1 — 通配符 * 全部放行
CHK-001 happy:2 — 删除 phaseTools 字段后 loadConfig 回退默认值
cases.execute: const fs=await import("fs");const path=await import("path");const cp=path.join($root,"koala.config.json");const orig=fs.readFileSync(cp,"utf-8");const o=JSON.parse(orig);delete o.phaseTools;fs.writeFileSync(cp,JSON.stringify(o));$ctx.rc();const c=$ctx.lc($root);fs.writeFileSync(cp,orig);$ctx.rc();return c.phaseTools!==undefined&&typeof c.phaseTools==="object"&&Object.keys(c.phaseTools).length>0

cases.name: CHK-001 edge:0 — 空数组阶段仅全局可用
CHK-001 edge:1 — 大小写不匹配被拒
CHK-001 edge:2 — 未知阶段 key 不影响已知阶段
CHK-001 edge:3 — 混合精确名与通配符
CHK-001 adv:0 — phaseTools 为字符串/数组/null → 降级全量放行
CHK-001 adv:1 — value 含 null/数字 → 非字符串被跳过，story_get 仍匹配
CHK-001 adv:2 — JSON 损坏 → 回退默认 phaseTools 仍有约束
cases.execute: const fs=await import("fs");const path=await import("path");const cp=path.join($root,"koala.config.json");const orig=fs.readFileSync(cp,"utf-8");fs.writeFileSync(cp,"{bad");$ctx.rc();let r=false;try{const c=$ctx.lc($root);r=c.phaseTools!==undefined&&!$ctx.f("bug_report","PLAN",c.phaseTools)}catch{}fs.writeFileSync(cp,orig);$ctx.rc();return r

cases.name: CHK-002 happy:0 — DEV 白名单命令全部通过过滤
cases.execute: const {execSync}=await import("child_process");const fs=await import("fs");const path=await import("path");const br=execSync("git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD",{cwd:$root,encoding:"utf-8",stdio:["pipe","pipe","pipe"]}).trim();if(br!=="main")return "skip";const idx=path.join($root,"docs/story/actives/B-44a6/index.json");const orig=fs.readFileSync(idx,"utf-8");const j=JSON.parse(orig);const oldPhase=j.phase;j.phase="DEV";fs.writeFileSync(idx,JSON.stringify(j,null,2));try{execSync("git checkout -b story/B-44a6",{cwd:$root,stdio:["pipe","pipe","pipe"]});const out=execSync("koala fixture_get --fixturePath=phase-tools",{cwd:$root,encoding:"utf-8",timeout:30000});return out.includes("fixture_get done")}finally{j.phase=oldPhase;fs.writeFileSync(idx,JSON.stringify(j,null,2));execSync("git checkout main",{cwd:$root,stdio:["pipe","pipe","pipe"]});try{execSync("git branch -D story/B-44a6",{cwd:$root,stdio:["pipe","pipe","pipe"]})}catch{}}

cases.name: CHK-002 happy:1 — main 分支 koala story_list 全量放行
cases.execute: const {execSync}=await import("child_process");const br=execSync("git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD",{cwd:$root,encoding:"utf-8",stdio:["pipe","pipe","pipe"]}).trim();if(br!=="main")return "skip";const out=execSync("koala story_list",{cwd:$root,encoding:"utf-8",timeout:30000});return out.includes("story_list done")

cases.name: CHK-002 happy:2 — PLAN 阶段允许 review 拒绝 test_auto/fixture
cases.execute: const {execSync}=await import("child_process");const br=execSync("git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD",{cwd:$root,encoding:"utf-8",stdio:["pipe","pipe","pipe"]}).trim();if(br!=="main")return "skip";try{execSync("git checkout -b story/B-0743",{cwd:$root,stdio:["pipe","pipe","pipe"]});let blocked=false;try{execSync("koala test_auto",{cwd:$root,encoding:"utf-8",timeout:10000,stdio:["pipe","pipe","pipe"]})}catch(e){blocked=e.stderr&&e.stderr.includes("不可用")}const ok=execSync("koala story_review --storyId=B-0743",{cwd:$root,encoding:"utf-8",timeout:30000});return blocked&&ok.includes("story_review done")}finally{execSync("git checkout main",{cwd:$root,stdio:["pipe","pipe","pipe"]});try{execSync("git branch -D story/B-0743",{cwd:$root,stdio:["pipe","pipe","pipe"]})}catch{}}

cases.name: CHK-002 edge:0 — readStory 不存在的 storyId 抛错
CHK-002 edge:1 — 非 git 目录 git rev-parse 失败
cases.execute: const {execSync}=await import("child_process");const os=await import("os");let threw=false;try{execSync("git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD",{cwd:os.tmpdir(),encoding:"utf-8",stdio:["pipe","pipe","pipe"]})}catch{threw=true}return threw

cases.name: CHK-002 edge:2 — story- 前缀不被识别
CHK-002 edge:3 — phase [*] 通配符全部放行
CHK-002 adv:0 — 50 次重试每次都被拒
CHK-002 adv:1 — 伪造 storyId readStory 抛错不静默放行
CHK-002 adv:2 — worktree 隔离：不同 phase 下同一命令结果不同
CHK-002 adv:3 — phase 为空字符串 → 仅全局可用不崩溃
CHK-003 happy:0 — DEV 阶段过滤：只含 DEV 命令
cases.execute: const {execSync}=await import("child_process");const fs=await import("fs");const path=await import("path");const br=execSync("git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD",{cwd:$root,encoding:"utf-8",stdio:["pipe","pipe","pipe"]}).trim();if(br!=="main")return "skip";const idx=path.join($root,"docs/story/actives/B-44a6/index.json");const orig=fs.readFileSync(idx,"utf-8");const j=JSON.parse(orig);const oldPhase=j.phase;j.phase="DEV";fs.writeFileSync(idx,JSON.stringify(j,null,2));try{execSync("git checkout -b story/B-44a6",{cwd:$root,stdio:["pipe","pipe","pipe"]});const out=execSync("koala help",{cwd:$root,encoding:"utf-8",timeout:30000});const hasDev=out.includes("fixture_batch_add")&&out.includes("test_auto");const hasPhase=out.includes("阶段: DEV");const noBugGroup=!out.includes("Bug:");const noReviewGroup=!out.includes("Review:");return hasDev&&hasPhase&&noBugGroup&&noReviewGroup}finally{j.phase=oldPhase;fs.writeFileSync(idx,JSON.stringify(j,null,2));execSync("git checkout main",{cwd:$root,stdio:["pipe","pipe","pipe"]});try{execSync("git branch -D story/B-44a6",{cwd:$root,stdio:["pipe","pipe","pipe"]})}catch{}}

cases.name: CHK-003 happy:1 — main 分支 koala help 列出全部命令
CHK-003 happy:2 — PLAN 阶段 getAllowedPatterns 含 review/advance
cases.execute: const pt=$ctx.lc($root).phaseTools;const p=$ctx.ap("PLAN",pt);const hasReview=p.includes("story_review");const hasAdvance=p.includes("story_advance");const {execSync}=await import("child_process");const br=execSync("git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD",{cwd:$root,encoding:"utf-8",stdio:["pipe","pipe","pipe"]}).trim();let headerCheck=true;if(br==="main"){const out=execSync("koala help",{cwd:$root,encoding:"utf-8",timeout:30000});headerCheck=!out.includes("当前 Story")}return hasReview&&hasAdvance&&headerCheck

cases.name: CHK-003 edge:0 — phaseTools[phase]=[*] → getAllowedPatterns 含通配符
CHK-003 edge:1 — phaseTools[phase]=[] → 仅全局命令
CHK-003 edge:2 — 未知阶段名 → getAllowedPatterns 只返回全局
CHK-003 edge:3 — help 在 CLI 中位于 phase gate 之前，不被过滤
cases.execute: const {execSync}=await import("child_process");const br=execSync("git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD",{cwd:$root,encoding:"utf-8",stdio:["pipe","pipe","pipe"]}).trim();if(br!=="main")return "skip";const out=execSync("koala help",{cwd:$root,encoding:"utf-8",timeout:30000});return out.includes("koala — AI-driven")

cases.name: CHK-003 adv:1 — phaseTools 删除后 loadConfig 回退默认不崩溃
cases.execute: const fs=await import("fs");const path=await import("path");const cp=path.join($root,"koala.config.json");const orig=fs.readFileSync(cp,"utf-8");const o=JSON.parse(orig);delete o.phaseTools;fs.writeFileSync(cp,JSON.stringify(o));$ctx.rc();let r=false;try{const c=$ctx.lc($root);r=c.phaseTools!==undefined&&Object.keys(c.phaseTools).length>0}catch{}fs.writeFileSync(cp,orig);$ctx.rc();return r

cases.name: CHK-003 adv:2 — git 分支检测不依赖环境变量
cases.execute: const {execSync}=await import("child_process");const br=execSync("git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD",{cwd:$root,encoding:"utf-8",stdio:["pipe","pipe","pipe"]}).trim();if(br!=="main")return "skip";const env=Object.assign({},process.env,{LATTICE_PHASE:"TEST"});const out=execSync("koala help",{cwd:$root,encoding:"utf-8",timeout:30000,env:env});return out.includes("story_create")&&out.includes("bug_report")&&!out.includes("当前 Story")
